$schema: Machine-readable feature state tracker. Source of truth for status; per-feature MD docs are source of truth for design/runtime.

policy.definition_of_done: implementation complete + verify-done passed + feature MD updated + brain coherent

features.name: Split-Flap Board
features.description: 6x24 split-flap board: BoardMessage/BoardGrid Effect Schema + deterministic layout compiler + repair pass, D1 board/board_snapshot, BoardRoom Durable Object (WS hibernation, one per board, revision-ordered writes), and the full-screen TV display route /b/:boardId targeting the Samsung TV browser.
features.evidence: Phases 1-3 complete. feature-verifier verdict PASS (.brain/features/split-flap-board/verifications/2026-07-27.md), 8 screenshots. flap-tile count exactly 144, grid 24x6, board 1280x640 in a 1280x720 viewport, scrollable=false, zero jsErrors across all 7 steps. Flip measured by in-page rAF sampling: first tile 117ms, peak 42 faces at 267ms, settled by 449ms, mid-flip rotateX ~17.3deg. Settled text read from data-char = HELLO TV / FLAPPYBOARD with 8 yellow + 11 green from data-color. Live two-client sync 1.5ms vs a <300ms bar; board isolation and socket-path D1 persistence proven (board.revision=4 matching snapshots 1-4). Unknown board = true HTTP 404, now with a themed dark kiosk boundary. Gate: typecheck exit 0, Tests 460 passed (460) across 32 files, build exit 0 with the BOARD durable_objects binding + new_sqlite_classes migration present in the emitted build/server/wrangler.json. Fixed en route: a merged Effect layer builds every member so a missing R2 binding was 500ing every request (Bucket moved out of the global runtime); the DO never bumped board.revision; the wire silently relabelled an automation source as manual; and login/signup forms defaulted to GET, putting passwords in the URL when unhydrated.

features.name: Phone Control
features.description: Scan-to-pair phone controller at /b/:boardId/c: short-TTL single-use HMAC pairing token from the TV's QR exchanged for a DO-scoped controller grant (no phone login), manual row/color editor with live preview, history re-flip, and board sound-pack/mute settings.
features.evidence: Phase 4 complete and verified. feature-verifier verdict PASS (.brain/features/phone-control/verifications/2026-07-27.md) with 10 screenshots; golden path 6/6, error paths 2/2, zero jsErrors, zero networkErrors. Core claim proven not assumed: a fresh 390x844 context asserted to hold ZERO cookies redeemed the QR token, ended holding exactly one HttpOnly fb_grant_seed-board cookie and NO auth session cookie, final URL stripped of t=, control-root data-access=grant, and from that state it sent a message, changed sound pack, muted, and re-flipped history. Revision semantics measured from the TVs own WebSocket frames: grid writes 41->42->43 and history re-flip 43->44, while mute plus sound-pack held 42->42 with a byte-identical grid and a captured frame reading revision=42 muted=true. Security: HMAC-SHA256 over crypto.subtle, signed message prefix|boardId.length|boardId|payload giving domain separation plus MAC-audience binding, verify order structure->signature->claims, constant-time compare, 512-char ceiling before crypto, injected clock. Single-use enforced in the board Durable Object under blockConcurrencyWhile: 6 concurrent redemptions of one token returned 200 401 401 401 401 401, and a replay after a full dev-server restart was still refused, proving it is storage-backed. Authorisation matrix on /api/board-ws: no session+no grant on a real board 404, invented board 404, unrelated cookie 404, forged grant 401, real-board grant for an invented board 404, valid grant with no session 101, owner session 101 — so non-enumerability depends only on what the caller sent. Gate: typecheck exit 0 with 0 error TS lines, Tests 538 passed (538) across 34 files, build exit 0. NOT PROVEN: the final mute->silence hop (playerRef.setMuted) is Web Audio and not observable headlessly; frame delivery at an unchanged revision is proven, the audible result is not. ALSO OUTSTANDING: the controller UI is functional but unstyled relative to the board, and its white/black colour swatches are visually identical — both tracked as follow-up work, neither affecting the verified behaviour.

features.name: LLM Board Agent
features.description: Walkie-talkie board generation: MediaRecorder audio -> Workers AI Whisper transcript -> claude-sonnet-5 structured output -> Effect Schema decode with retry-twice-then-repair, so the board always lands on a valid 6x24 grid. One shot per press, no conversation state.
features.evidence: Shipped in v0.1.0 (PR #2, squash-merged as f8ae90f, 2026-07-27) and held open afterwards only for a formal verdict doc and its blocking follow-up; both now exist, so the status is being corrected to match what actually shipped. Phase 5: BoardAgent on claude-sonnet-5 with schema-enforced output and decode -> retry x2 with the error fed back -> deterministic repair; live eval 20/20 valid grids, 0 retries, 0 repairs on the real model. Phase 6: Workers AI Whisper + hold-to-talk, verified against the real Cloudflare account — a real call returned a transcript and wrote the board. Blocking follow-up issue #1 (no rate limit or spend cap on the two paid endpoints) closed 2026-07-28 in abd0eea: atomic per-spender + per-board check-and-increment in the BoardRoom Durable Object, RateLimitError -> TOO_MANY_REQUESTS, 429 + Retry-After on the non-tRPC transcribe route. Verdict doc .brain/features/llm-board-agent/verifications/2026-07-28.md (PASS) proves four claims live against a real DO: the cap bites at attempt 21 with a usable retryAfter; 30 concurrent calls at a limit of 20 admitted exactly 20, so no increments are lost under contention; an exhausted owner still left a freshly paired grant its own full 20; and a 4th grant with a brand-new nonce was refused on its very first call at 60/60, closing the re-pairing bypass. Gate: typecheck exit 0, Tests 892 passed (892) across 45 files, build exit 0, e2e 2 passed, harness-check 7/7 with brain check 9/9. KNOWN GAPS, none blocking: the 2026-07-28 verdict doc is scoped to the spend caps and is not a browser walk of the voice-to-board path, which was proven by the live phase-6 call rather than by a screenshotted verification; /api/transcribe's 429 shares the same spendQuota call and ledger as generate but was not driven live because the AI binding always hits remote Cloudflare; fail-closed on a broken ledger is unit-tested at the service boundary only; and no screenshots accompany this verdict because the surface under test is a tRPC error code and an HTTP status, not a rendered view.

features.name: TV Pairing
features.description: Device-code pairing so a TV reaches a board without the owner's login: /tv shows a short single-use code and holds a WebSocket to the BoardRoom DO, the owner approves from /link on their phone, and a handoff request banks an HttpOnly fb_device_<boardId> grant. Third token family fbd1 alongside the existing fbp1/fbg1.
features.evidence: Browser-verified PASS across TWO independent worker runs that agreed on every step; verdict doc .brain/features/tv-pairing/verifications/2026-07-28.md with 7 screenshots. Central claim proven not assumed, using two isolated browser contexts: a TV context ASSERTED to hold zero cookies (context.cookies() === []) ended up rendering a live board with exactly 144 flap-tile elements while holding EXACTLY ONE cookie, HttpOnly fb_device_<boardId> SameSite=Lax, and NO auth session cookie — and it got there by socket push without a reload. Two runs minted two different codes (GHPLXX, T8TRA3), so the code is per-TV rather than fixed. Error paths: a bogus code is refused ('No TV is waiting on that code. Check it, or reload the TV for a new one.'); the SAME code replayed a second time is refused identically with link-success never shown, so single-use holds; a cookie-evicted TV is redirected to /tv for a fresh code rather than 404 (the mitigation decision 2 exists for, since Samsung's browser evicts aggressively); and a cookie-less stranger hitting /b/<boardId> directly gets HTTP 302 to /tv, confirmed with curl, never seeing board content. Run B also confirmed no horizontal scroll (scrollWidth 1280 === clientWidth 1280). Zero jsErrors in either run; only 200@login on the network. ONE WORKER CLAIM DID NOT SURVIVE CHECKING and is recorded rather than quietly dropped: run B reported a '~15-day' device cookie expiry, which would have contradicted the 180-day grant and mattered because decision 2 makes cookie lifetime load-bearing — measured instead, Max-Age=15552000 is exactly 180 days and claimHandoff passes DEFAULT_DEVICE_TTL_SECONDS (app/trpc/routes/board.ts:1230); it was a misreading of the leading digits, not a defect. Gate: typecheck 0, Tests 1166 passed (1166) across 50 files, build exit 0, e2e 2 passed, harness-check 7/7. KNOWN GAP, owner-only and decisive for decision 2: power-cycle the real Samsung TV to confirm the cookie PERSISTS — the walk proves graceful recovery when it is gone, not persistence. Also unit-tested rather than driven live: concurrent redemption of one code, and the approve-device spend cap at its limit.

features.name: Family Grants
features.description: Controller grants that survive daily life: 30-day sliding TTL renewed on socket upgrade (up from the 12h DEFAULT_GRANT_TTL_SECONDS), an optional device name captured once at pairing, and per-device revoke on /boards alongside the existing grantEpoch bump.
features.evidence: Two browser walks PASS: verifications/2026-07-28.md (30-day TTL measured from the signed payload, per-device revoke isolation proven by write outcome, grantEpoch bump kills all three phones uniformly) + verifications/2026-07-29.md (naming delta closing finding 1: prompt offered to unnamed phones only, saved name reaches the owner list, rows distinguishable, un-pair-by-name kills exactly that phone by measured 401-vs-200, whitespace refused 400). Gate: typecheck 0, 1185 tests (50 files), build 0, e2e 2/2, harness-check 7/7. Owner call 2026-07-29 ratified the post-pairing name offer over an interstitial.

features.name: Kiosk Display
features.description: Make /b/:boardId survive months on a wall: Wake Lock with a silent-video fallback as the primary path, fullscreen on the existing keydown gesture, a single-shot socket watchdog reload, a reconnect spinner over the retained grid, and pixel drift plus idle dim for burn-in.
features.evidence: Browser walk PASS (verifications/2026-07-29.md, two walks): 144 tiles / 24x6 / scrollable=false WITH drift active, drift tick measured at exactly 240.1s, scrim over retained grid with revision unchanged, watchdog reload at +122s then NO second reload across a 300s window (walk 1 measured the loop — useRef latch reset by reload; fixed via sessionStorage createReloadLatch, one reload per outage, re-armed on live, storage failure degrades to no reload), recovery 503ms, second outage re-armed the latch (+152s). jsErrors/networkErrors none. Gate: typecheck 0, 1191 tests (+6), build 0, e2e 2/2, harness 7/7. Samsung setup recipe written (recipes/samsung-tv-setup.md). Owner-only and outstanding by design: 8h soak + real Samsung TV walk; finding 2 (wedged socket invisible to watchdog) awaits an owner call.

features.name: Live Weather
features.description: Replace the web_search path for weather with a real weather API (Open-Meteo): a third router route that pre-fetches typed readings, a day-long hourly-series cache, and location inferred from the phone. web_search stays for scores and news.
features.evidence: planned 2026-07-28 from plans/2026-07-28-live-weather.html (reviewed 2 rounds; ALL 7 decisions answered). Motivated by a measured defect: temperature 6-10C wrong in every configuration tried, plus one invented segment (FEELS LIKE EVENING 5C) recorded in the run-C verification doc. Round 2: cache in a NEW KV binding, location rounded to ~10km with a place-name fallback. BLOCKED on an owner-only 'wrangler kv namespace create' (real credentials, real resource) and deferred by decision 5 behind feat-010/011/012 verification. CRITICAL constraint recorded in the feature doc: the weather service must NOT join makeAppRuntime's merged layer — a merged Effect layer constructs every member, which is how an absent R2 binding once 500'd every request in the app (see feat-003).

features.name: QR-First TV Link
features.description: Make the QR code the default on /tv: the QR encodes /link?code=<CODE>, a logged-out scan lands on /login and returns via a validated ?next= param, and /link can create+name a board inline (create-and-approve) instead of requiring an existing board. Typed 6-char code stays as fallback; pairing protocol unchanged.
features.evidence: Browser-verified PASS (.brain/features/qr-first-tv-link/verifications/2026-07-29.md, 17 assertions + 2-addendum): TV QR encodes /link?code=4UG28E (data-link-url asserted), zero-cookie phone scan lands on /login?next= and round-trips back with the code prefilled, create+name pairs inline, TV flips to exactly 144 flap-tiles with one HttpOnly fb_device_<boardId> cookie and no reload, controller reachable from success. Error paths: ?next=//evil.com never leaves origin; bogus code refused with no TV change. Verification found create-and-approve non-atomic (orphan board on bogus code) — fixed with rollback delete, re-verified R1 (36->36 boards, no orphan) R2 (success hides submit, LUBG4H paired). Gate: typecheck 0, 1201 tests, build 0, e2e 2/2, harness-check clean.

features.name: Controller Board Mirror
features.description: The phone controller (/b/:boardId/c) renders the live board inline — a collapsible, silent, container-sized BoardGridView 'inline' variant fed by the socket the controller already holds — so the operator never has to look at the TV.
features.evidence: Browser-verified PASS (.brain/features/controller-board-mirror/verifications/2026-07-29.md, 11 assertions, walk run 3x): mirror open by default with exactly 144 flap-tiles; write from the same phone updates the mirror board-grid aria-label live with no reload and settles to data-flap-moving=0; collapse toggle removes/restores the grid; TV display route unaffected (144 tiles in board-frame, zero board-mirror elements); reduced-motion emulation updates instantly, zero jsErrors. Gate: typecheck 0, 1201 tests, build 0, e2e 2/2, harness-check clean.

features.name: Pairing Experience Redesign
features.description: Refero-guided redesign of the pairing+controller journey: bring /tv and /link onto the console design system (tonal ladder, hairline-lip plates, wells, SegmentTrack, amber pilot lamp, mono readouts), dark-form technical musts (color-scheme, theme-color, focus-visible bezels, touch targets), and Orientation+Status+Action copy. Login stays on the app light theme (account door, not remote).
features.evidence: Browser-verified PASS (.brain/features/pairing-experience-redesign/verifications/2026-07-29.md, 26 assertions + 5 re-checks): measured console rgb values on /tv (bg 0,0,0; QR plate 21,21,21; readout 34,34,38; amber pilot lamp 255,204,0; color-scheme/theme-color metas) and /link (wells 14,14,16; track 34,34,38); full journey regression scan->login->name->TV flips 144->controller mirror; no-JS contract proven with JavaScript disabled (CSS :checked reveal + native POST paired); a11y: 48px submit, 44px mirror toggle, role=status/alert, bogus-code no orphan (39->39); login seam intentionally light. Walk caught E1: focus ring dead under inline box-shadow — fixed with amber outline composition, re-verified focused+unfocused on all three INK_KEY/well consumers. Gate: typecheck 0, 1201 tests, build 0, e2e 2/2 (earlier), harness-check clean.

features.name: Auto TV Link
features.description: Zero-typing TV pairing: scan -> login (if needed) -> automatically linked. The /link loader auto-resolves when a valid code arrives: 0 boards creates one with a locale-aware default name and pairs it, exactly 1 board pairs it, multiple boards falls back to the picker (manual=1 escape). GET-with-side-effect in the loader follows the /tv/claim precedent (single-use credential redemption).
features.evidence: Browser-verified PASS (.brain/features/auto-tv-link/verifications/2026-07-29.md, 16 assertions, 6 scenarios): HEADLINE fresh sign-up 0-boards — scan 7LKCSW, sign-up carries next, registration lands on link-auto-success with zero further interaction (Living Room created), TV flips 144 tiles no-reload, one HttpOnly fb_device_ cookie, /boards==[Living Room]. 1-board auto-pairs (paired copy, not created). Multi-board (admin) gets picker. Bogus code ZZZZZ9 falls to form with not-found, no orphan (rollback). manual=1 escape both directions. /tv regression clean (FCKEGB). Gate: typecheck 0, 1207 tests, build 0, e2e 2/2, harness clean.

features.name: OpenTelemetry Span Tracing
features.description: Effect span tracing across tRPC procedures, repositories, and services. Custom Effect Tracer exports OTLP JSON via fetch to an env-configured endpoint (OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT + OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS + OTEL_SERVICE_NAME); complete no-op when endpoint unset. Logger auto-annotates every log with traceId/spanId from the current span so logs and traces correlate. Ships with a span-instrumenter sub-agent + rules/recipe updates so every new endpoint gets instrumented.
features.evidence: Synced from cf-saas-starter-react-router 0ae0796 (template #20) on 2026-07-31, then extended: upstream instrumented its 15 procedures, this repo's board/boards/tv/agent routers were span-named here. Gate on our tree: typecheck PASS, unit tests PASS, harness-check 10/10. NOT live-verified on this repo — upstream captured a real OTLP trace on the template's dev server; flappyboard's own OTLP capture is still owed, and export is inert until OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT is set.

features.name: Brand System
features.description: Phase 1 of the approved brand/IA/UX redesign — extract the board's researched hardware design language into the real token contract. Retuned global semantic tokens + a [data-surface="hardware"] scoped override (first use of the documented escape hatch), radius 2px, amber promoted to --signal (never --primary), 8 flap pigments mirrored as --flap-* with a parity test, two self-hosted OFL typefaces (Archivo + IBM Plex Mono) replacing the runtime Google Fonts link, and the app-wide focus-ring fix. Board render frozen.
features.evidence: Merged as 80f1601 (PR #11). Board render frozen with zero drift across three golden comparisons; focus ring now paints, replacing one that measured 1.41:1 and was invisible; non-leakage proven; every contrast pairing computed. Gates: typecheck 0, 1256 tests, build 0, harness 10/10, browser walk 17/17. design-critic DO NOT SHIP with 4 P1s — one refuted by measurement, one fixed in 69bf883, two carried into phase 2/3 as blocking criteria because both live on /boards, which phase 2 rebuilds.

features.name: App IA & Navigation
features.description: Phase 2 of the brand/IA/UX redesign. Deletes /dashboard (its own shipped copy calls it "the post-auth landing page of the boilerplate", four explore cards all disabled={!isAdmin}), deletes the six broken /:lng alias routes, reduces /boards from 560 lines to a thin switcher, builds the shared management shell (header + user menu), and adds sign-out for non-admin users (authClient.signOut() currently exists in exactly one file, admin/layout/nav-user.tsx:49). Adds a pure resolveSignedInHome(boardCount) beside resolveAutoLink's precedent. Adds redirect shims so no existing URL 404s. Phase 3 (console-journey-v2) ships in the same PR by owner decision.
features.evidence: PR #12 (open, mergeable): https://github.com/SeanningTatum/flappyboard/pull/12 — /dashboard and the six /:lng aliases deleted with redirect shims, /boards reduced to a thin rack, ConsoleShell added (closes the defect where a non-admin could never sign out), admin sidebar gains a Boards entry. Verified: .brain/features/app-ia/verifications/2026-07-31.md (PASS).

features.name: Console Journey v2
features.description: Phase 3 of the redesign, shipped in the same PR as app-ia. Deletes resolveAutoLink, the board picker, the <select>, the receipt page and /link's entire manual mode — a board IS a TV, so scanning always creates one and lands the user on the controller with nothing to answer (5 stops -> 3). The pairing code on /tv becomes six live flap tiles. The controller gains Content|Settings tabs at the frozen /b/:boardId/c path, Settings absorbing the TV address, paired devices with count, rename, un-pair and delete. Device naming moves inline into the nameplate. The composer's live grid becomes the primary instrument.
features.evidence: PR #12 (open, mergeable): https://github.com/SeanningTatum/flappyboard/pull/12 — resolveAutoLink, the board picker, the <select>, the receipt and /link's manual mode all deleted; /link is ~300 L with no UI on the happy path and its code field set in real flaps; the controller is Content|Settings tabs at the frozen /b/:boardId/c. Verified: .brain/features/console-journey-v2/verifications/2026-07-31.md (PASS), three design-critic rounds ending SHIP.

features.name: Front Door
features.description: Phase 4 of the redesign. Rewrites the public landing page: home.tsx today returns title "Cloudflare SaaS Starter", six cards advertising the stack, a section printing /start-task and .brain/recipes/ paths to end users, and a Quickstart terminal printing bun install. It is replaced by one screen — a live board that spells its own headline and flips once on load, "Put it on your TV" -> sign-up, and the instruction the product has never given anywhere: on your TV's browser, go to yourhost/tv. home.json is rewritten in both locales. Login and sign-up merge into one toggled page, defaulting to sign-up when `next` carries a pairing code. feature-card.tsx dies with the old page.
